c0502.en: ▸ This is the checklist for the WHOLE SHOP: what gets opened and closed for the entire business, not for each area. Use it as the backbone of the day.

c0504.en: ▸ Print the shift sheet (opening or closing) or use it on a tablet; the shift lead assigns tasks and each person initials theirs.

c0505.en: ▸ Each task comes with Assigned to and Due by preloaded with the kit's criteria: adjust them to your real schedule, they are green cells.

c0507.en: ▸ Everything filled in daily is GREEN: Assigned to, Due by, ✓ Done, Initials and Notes.

c0509.en: ▸ Mark ✓ in the "✓ Done" column (dropdown): that is the column that counts completed tasks.

c0510.en: ▸ "N/A" = not applicable at your shop: that task comes OUT of the total (don't delete it, mark it N/A). "—" = not done: it still counts as pending and lowers the percentage, which is the point.

c0511.en: ▸ The denominator counts the tasks written in the "Task" column, not a fixed number: if you add or delete tasks, the total adjusts by itself.

c0513.en: ▸ At the end of each table there are 5 free green rows INSIDE the range the counter covers: write your own tasks there.

c0514.en: ▸ If you need more, insert rows INSIDE the table (right-click → Insert), never below the last one: anything typed outside the range is not counted.

c0516.en: ▸ Sheets with formulas are protected WITHOUT a password: the input cells (the green ones) are unlocked, so calculations never get overwritten by accident.

c0517.en: ▸ You can insert and delete rows with protection on. To change the structure: Review → Unprotect Sheet.

c0519.en: ▸ 08-chocolate-store-opening-closing-checklist.xlsx — checklist for the WHOLE SHOP: it is the BACKBONE of the day.

c0520.en: ▸ 09-cash-drawer-opening-closing.xlsx — the CASH: starting bank, count by denomination, POS Z report and over/short.

c0521.en: ▸ Order of use: shop → register. Each file covers one level: the shop file marks the MILESTONE (turn on, open, close) and the cash file carries the MONEY. If a task shows up in both, it's on purpose: one is the milestone and the other the detail.

c0522.en: ▸ You are in 08-chocolate-store-opening-closing-checklist.xlsx: this IS the backbone of the day — the MILESTONE of opening and closing the shop; the MONEY is in 09-cash-drawer-opening-closing.xlsx.

c0578.en: ▸ The daily cash count: starting bank, drawer count by denomination, POS Z report and over/short — plus the monthly log to see at a glance which days didn't balance.

c0579.en: How to use — Cash Drawer Opening

c0580.en: ▸ Count the starting bank and type the amount in the GREEN cell "Starting bank (opening float)". The closing sheet reads it from there: no need to retype it.

c0581.en: How to use — Cash Drawer Closing

c0582.en: ▸ In "Cash Count by Denomination" fill in ONLY the "Quantity" column (number of bills or coins, whole number): the subtotal and TOTAL CASH calculate themselves. The table has US bills and coins (the penny is no longer minted but is still legal tender; a "25¢ roll" counts $10 and a "10¢ roll" $5). In the UK, Canada or Australia, unprotect the sheet (no password) and change the label and value of each row.

c0583.en: ▸ In the "Closing Summary" you only type three figures: "Card sales, excl. tips", "Other tenders + card tips paid in cash" and "POS Z report: sales + tax, excl. tips" (net sales plus sales tax, without tips or gratuities; many POS "total" lines include tips). Everything else is a formula.

c0584.en: ▸ The starting bank is deducted automatically: TOTAL COLLECTED = (cash counted − starting bank) + card sales + other.

c0585.en: ▸ OVER / SHORT = TOTAL COLLECTED − POS Z report (sales + tax, excl. tips). If the cell turns AMBER, the drawer doesn't balance: check it BEFORE signing.

c0586.en: ▸ One row per day: enter starting bank, sales by payment type, POS Z report and deposit; Total Collected and Over/Short calculate themselves and the over/short turns amber.

c0587.en: ▸ The starting bank is a balance, not a sale: the TOTALS row shows the AVERAGE starting bank of the days logged, not their sum.

c0588.en: ▸ Everything filled in daily is GREEN: Assigned to, Due by, ✓ Done, Initials, Notes, the count quantities and the summary amounts.

c0589.en: ▸ You are in 09-cash-drawer-opening-closing.xlsx: this is the REGISTER — the day's MONEY (starting bank, count, POS Z report and over/short); the backbone of the day is in 08-chocolate-store-opening-closing-checklist.xlsx.

c0615.en: Total collected = (cash counted − starting bank) + card sales + other

c0616.en: Compare with the POS Z report → calculate the over/short

c0658.en: Enter how many bills, coins or rolls: a whole number (0 or more), no decimals.

c0671.en: "Cash Counted" is the drawer count AS IS, with the starting bank inside: Total Collected already deducts it. In TOTALS, "Starting Bank" is the AVERAGE starting bank of the days logged (a balance is not summed) and "Over/Short" is the CUMULATIVE over/short in absolute value: a +50 and a −50 make 100 of over/short, not 0. "Card Sales (no tips)" excludes tips; "Other + Tips Paid" = other tenders + card tips paid in cash from the drawer. "POS Z" = net sales + sales tax, without tips.
